name: Testosterone
description: A laboratory check of total testosterone, using a small blood sample collected at home.
result_time: Usually 2–5 working days for analysis and reporting; follow the turnaround confirmed with your kit.
results_access: Our testing partner’s secure results portal
limitations: This measures total testosterone, not the wider Male Hormone panel. One result does not establish a diagnosis or mean you need testosterone treatment.

name: Diabetes
description: A laboratory HbA1c test reflecting your average blood glucose over the previous two to three months.
result_time: Usually 2–5 working days for analysis and reporting; follow the turnaround confirmed with your kit.
results_access: Our testing partner’s secure results portal
limitations: HbA1c does not explain every symptom or replace an assessment. If you already have diabetes, follow the monitoring plan agreed with your care team.

name: PSA
description: A forthcoming laboratory PSA test, collected at home and returned for analysis.
result_time: Timing to be confirmed at launch
results_access: Our testing partner’s secure results portal
limitations: PSA can be raised for several reasons. A raised result does not diagnose prostate cancer, and a low result cannot rule it out. Discuss the benefits and limits of PSA testing with your GP.

name: Male Hormone
markers_json: ["Testosterone","Free testosterone","Luteinising hormone (LH)","Follicle stimulating hormone (FSH)","Oestradiol","Prolactin","Sex hormone binding globulin (SHBG)","Albumin"]
description: A forthcoming laboratory panel of hormones and related markers, including total and free testosterone.
result_time: Timing to be confirmed at launch
results_access: Our testing partner’s secure results portal
limitations: Hormone results need the right sampling and clinical context. A panel does not establish the cause of every symptom or automatically indicate treatment.

name: Heart Health
description: A forthcoming laboratory lipid panel covering several cholesterol measures and triglycerides.
result_time: Timing to be confirmed at launch
results_access: Our testing partner’s secure results portal
limitations: These blood markers are one part of the picture. This is not a complete assessment of your heart or a test for acute chest symptoms.

name: Bowel Health
description: A home FIT self-test that checks a small stool sample for blood you may not be able to see.
result_time: Around 5 minutes after running the test; follow the supplied reading window.
results_access: Read at home using the kit instructions
limitations: Blood can have several causes. This test cannot diagnose or rule out bowel cancer and does not replace NHS screening or assessment of symptoms.

name: Prostate Health
description: A finger-prick PSA self-test, completed and read at home in around five minutes.
result_time: Around 5 minutes after running the test; follow the supplied reading window.
results_access: Read at home using the kit instructions
limitations: PSA can be raised for several reasons. A raised result does not diagnose prostate cancer, and a low result cannot rule it out. Discuss the benefits and limits of PSA testing with your GP.

name: Male Fertility
description: A semen self-test that checks sperm concentration as one indicator of male fertility.
result_time: Around 5 minutes after running the test; follow the supplied reading window.
results_access: Read at home using the kit instructions
limitations: Sperm concentration is only one part of fertility. This is not a full semen analysis, which also looks at features such as sperm movement and shape.

name: Cholesterol
description: A finger-prick self-test that shows the band your total cholesterol falls into, using a colour guide.
result_time: Around 2 minutes after running the test; follow the supplied reading window.
results_access: Read at home using the kit instructions
limitations: This checks total cholesterol. It does not give the separate HDL, LDL and triglyceride results of the Heart Health lab panel.

name: Vitamin D
description: A finger-prick vitamin D self-test, with a result read at home using the supplied guide.
result_time: Around 10 minutes after running the test; follow the supplied reading window.
results_access: Read at home using the kit instructions
limitations: A self-test alone does not determine which supplement or dose is suitable for you. Follow the supplied guide and seek advice about a result that concerns you.

name: Iron Deficiency
description: A ferritin self-test using a finger-prick sample. Ferritin is a protein associated with stored iron.
result_time: Around 5 minutes after running the test; follow the supplied reading window.
results_access: Read at home using the kit instructions
limitations: This is not a full blood count and cannot investigate every cause of anaemia or tiredness. A result is not an automatic reason to start iron supplements.

name: Thyroid
description: A finger-prick self-test for TSH, used as an indicator of a possible underactive thyroid.
result_time: Around 10 minutes after running the test; follow the supplied reading window.
results_access: Read at home using the kit instructions
limitations: This is not a full thyroid panel. It cannot explain every cause of tiredness or weight change, and a result needs the right medical context.

name: Kidney Health
description: A urine self-test that checks for increased albumin, a marker that may need further assessment.
result_time: Around 3 minutes after running the test; follow the supplied reading window.
results_access: Read at home using the kit instructions
limitations: This is not a complete kidney-function assessment. A result cannot establish or exclude chronic kidney disease on its own.

name: Multivitamin
description: A capsule supplement containing a blend of vitamins, minerals and other nutrients.
result_time: Follow the final product label
results_access: Product label and directions
limitations: Food comes first. Check the final ingredients, allergens and directions, including overlap with any supplements you already take.

name: Vitamin D Supplement
description: A vegan vitamin D3 supplement listed at 1,000 IU per serving.
result_time: Follow the final product label
results_access: Product label and directions
limitations: Check the final label and directions. A test result alone does not set the right dose for you.

name: Iron Supplement
description: An iron bisglycinate supplement listed with 20 mg of elemental iron per capsule.
result_time: Follow the final product label
results_access: Product label and directions
limitations: Not everyone needs extra iron. Do not treat a home test as a complete assessment of the cause of low iron.

name: General Health
description: Five home self-tests, brought together: thyroid, vitamin D, iron, cholesterol and kidney health.
result_time: Varies by included test
results_access: Read each product’s instructions
limitations: A bundle is not a complete health assessment or a personalised recommendation. Supplements remain optional; final contents and quantities must be confirmed.

name: General Health Combo
description: The five General Health self-tests with an optional multivitamin in the same proposed bundle.
result_time: Varies by included test
results_access: Read each product’s instructions
limitations: A bundle is not a complete health assessment or a personalised recommendation. Supplements remain optional; final contents and quantities must be confirmed.

name: Vitamin D Combo
description: Vitamin D testing, a supplement and follow-up testing brought together. Final quantities and timing will be confirmed.
result_time: Varies by included test
results_access: Read each product’s instructions
limitations: A bundle is not a complete health assessment or a personalised recommendation. Supplements remain optional; final contents and quantities must be confirmed.

name: Iron Deficiency Combo
description: Iron-deficiency testing, an iron supplement and follow-up testing brought together. Check that supplementation is appropriate for you.
result_time: Varies by included test
results_access: Read each product’s instructions
limitations: A bundle is not a complete health assessment or a personalised recommendation. Supplements remain optional; final contents and quantities must be confirmed.
